ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity (white/off-white) to 35% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixel distribution across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity cluster originates at the fluke base, bifurcating into a divergent V-shape. High-intensity fields dominate the medial and lateral lobe regions, enclosed by a continuous, irregular low-intensity perimeter along the trailing edge and tips. Isolated low-intensity streaks and punctate clusters are distributed asymmetrically across both white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 62 degrees; depth extends to the terminus of the central dark pigmentation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, multi-amplitude serrations along the continuous linear boundary; primary peaks are concentrated in the medial-to-distal transition zones of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a consistent concave curvature from the median notch to the lateral tips; leading edge (where visible) indicates a convex trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two primary high-contrast, multi-tonal (tan, white, and black) clusters representing dense calcified colonization localized at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple unaligned, low-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks); specifically, four distinct parallel-diagonal streaks on the right lobe white field and three irregular vertical-diagonal streaks on the left lobe white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological encrustation (barnacle clusters) present on both terminal tips, causing localized topographical deformation of the fluke silhouette.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized yellowish-brown pixel intensity shift (possible diatom film or staining) visible on the medial portion of the right lobe's high-intensity field.
